title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
sort: Girl with the Dragon Tattoo, The
note: during The Game ep, Bill says they'll probably need to do all of the movies David Fincher directed
plot: Disgraced journalist Mikael Blomkvist investigates the disappearance of a weary patriarch's niece from 40 years ago. He is aided by the pierced, tattooed, punk computer hacker named Lisbeth Salander. As they work together in the investigation, Blomkvist and Salander uncover immense corruption beyond anything they have ever imagined.
